newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Treasuries open steady, all eyes on jobs data.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Treasuries open steady, all eyes on jobs data.

text.p: U.S. Treasuries opened mostly unchanged on Friday, with the market expected to take its early cues from this morning's May employment report.

The Labor Department will release the report at 0830 EDT/1230 GMT, but market participants said it may take a few minutes for the market to fully digest the data because the recent seasonal adjustments may require more interpretation that usual.
"If you told me the headline (payroll) print now, I wouldn't be able to tell you what to do," said Larry Dyer, Treasury market strategist at Credit Suisse First Boston Corp.
